Game.doc:
The game under test. Every test starts on the main menu of a new game (data cleared).

Pages are reached as attributes (`game.store`, `game.main_menu`, ...). Readers named
`*_shown()` return what the screen displays; `*_state()` readers return game data. Tests
assert on what the player sees and may cross-check game data.

main_menu.doc: The main menu: navigation and the character/theme/accessory/power-up selectors.

player.doc: The player's data as the game holds it (`*_state()` readers).

restart.doc:
Close the game and open it again, keeping its saved data (like a player quitting
and coming back). Returns on the main menu, after pressing START.

run.doc: The run in progress: HUD, pause, second chance.

screen_shown.doc: Which screen is in front right now.

setup.doc: Test-setup helpers that write the player's data directly. Arrange only.

store.doc: The store and its four sections.

GameOver.doc:
Shown after declining to continue. When a mission was completed, the game opens the
missions popup over it; close that (`game.missions.close()`) before using these buttons.

go_to_main_menu.doc: Press Main Menu; returns once the main menu is shown.

is_shown.doc: True when the game-over screen is in front (no popup over it).

open_leaderboard.doc: Open the leaderboard from the game-over screen.

open_missions.doc: Open the missions popup from the game-over screen.

open_store.doc: Open the store from the game-over screen.

run_again.doc: Press Run! to start a new run; returns once the run HUD is shown.

score_shown.doc: The final score shown for the run that just ended.

Leaderboard.doc: The leaderboard, opened from the main menu or the game-over screen.

close.doc: Close the leaderboard. Precondition: leaderboard open.

entries_shown.doc:
Leaderboard lines that are on screen and have a score, top to bottom.
Precondition: leaderboard open.

is_shown.doc: True when the leaderboard is open.

MainMenu.doc: The screen shown after START and after leaving a run or the game-over screen.

accessory_shown.doc:
Name in the accessory selector, or None when the selector is not shown (the
selected character has no owned accessory).

character_arrows_shown.doc:
True when the character arrows are shown (the game shows them only when the player
owns more than one character).

character_shown.doc: Name of the selected character as displayed. Precondition: main menu shown.

is_shown.doc: True when the main menu is the screen in front (no store, popup or run over it).

next_accessory.doc:
Press the accessory up arrow; returns the accessory shown afterwards.
Precondition: accessory selector shown.

next_character.doc:
Press the right character arrow; returns the character name shown afterwards.
Precondition: character arrows shown.

next_power_up.doc:
Press the right power-up arrow to equip the next owned power-up (or none); returns
the count shown afterwards. Precondition: power-up selector shown.

next_theme.doc:
Press the right theme arrow; returns the theme name shown afterwards.
Precondition: theme arrows shown.

open_leaderboard.doc: Open the leaderboard. Precondition: main menu shown.

open_missions.doc: Open the missions popup. Precondition: main menu shown.

open_settings.doc: Open the settings popup. Precondition: main menu shown.

open_store.doc:
Open the store. Precondition: main menu shown. Ends with the store showing its
power-ups section.

power_up_count_shown.doc:
How many of the equipped power-up the player owns, as displayed; None when no
power-up is equipped or the selector is not shown.

power_up_selector_shown.doc: True when the power-up selector is shown (only when the player owns power-ups).

previous_accessory.doc:
Press the accessory down arrow; returns the accessory shown afterwards.
Precondition: accessory selector shown.

previous_character.doc:
Press the left character arrow; returns the character name shown afterwards.
Precondition: character arrows shown.

previous_power_up.doc:
Press the left power-up arrow; returns the count shown afterwards.
Precondition: power-up selector shown.

previous_theme.doc:
Press the left theme arrow; returns the theme name shown afterwards.
Precondition: theme arrows shown.

start_run.doc:
Press Run. Precondition: main menu shown. Returns once the run HUD is on screen.
On a new game the first run is the tutorial, which pauses at each obstacle until the
player swipes; call `game.setup.complete_tutorial()` first for a normal run.

theme_arrows_shown.doc: True when the theme arrows are shown (only when more than one theme is owned).

theme_shown.doc: Name of the selected theme as displayed. Precondition: main menu shown.

tutorial_shown.doc: True when the tutorial overlay covers the main menu (tutorial not completed).

Missions.doc: The missions popup. The game-over screen opens it by itself when a mission is complete.

claim.doc:
Press the claim button of the mission at `index` (0 = top) and wait until the list
is rebuilt. Precondition: missions popup open and that mission claimable.

close.doc: Close the popup. Precondition: missions popup open.

is_shown.doc: True when a missions popup is open.

missions_shown.doc: The missions listed, in display order. Precondition: missions popup open.

Player.doc: The player's saved progress and settings as the game holds them in memory.

missions_state.doc: Active missions with their progress, target and reward.

owned_accessories_state.doc: Owned accessories as stored by the game ("<character>:<accessory>" per entry).

owned_characters_state.doc: Names of the owned characters, in the order they were acquired.

power_ups_state.doc: Owned power-ups by store name ("Magnet", "x2", "Invincible", "Life") and count.

tutorial_completed_state.doc: True once the tutorial has been completed.

volumes_state.doc: Stored volumes converted to the settings sliders' 0.0-1.0 scale.

Run.doc: The run in progress, from pressing Run until the game-over screen.

character_state.doc: Name of the character actually running (game state). Precondition: run started.

coins_shown.doc: Coins collected in this run, as shown on the HUD.

coins_state.doc: Coins collected in this run (game state). Precondition: run started.

continue_cost_shown.doc: Premium price of continuing, as shown on the offer. Precondition: offer shown.

continue_enabled.doc: True when the pay-to-continue button can be pressed. Precondition: offer shown.

continue_with_premium.doc:
Pay premium to continue the same run; returns once the run HUD is back.
Precondition: offer shown and continuing enabled.

decline_continue.doc:
Press Game over on the offer; returns once the game-over screen is shown (with the
missions popup over it if a mission was completed). Precondition: offer shown.

distance_shown.doc: The distance on the HUD, in metres.

hud_shown.doc: Every HUD value at once. Precondition: run in progress or paused.

is_paused.doc: True while the pause menu is shown.

is_shown.doc: True while the run HUD is in front (not paused, no second-chance offer).

lives_shown.doc: Remaining lives: the HUD hearts still drawn white (lost lives turn black).

lives_state.doc: Remaining lives (game state). Precondition: run started.

multiplier_shown.doc: The score multiplier on the HUD.

pause.doc: Press pause. Precondition: run in front. Returns once the pause menu is shown.

play_until_out_of_lives.doc:
Let the run go on without input until every life is lost (the runner hits
obstacles on its own). Returns when the second-chance offer is shown.
Precondition: a normal run in progress (not the tutorial, which waits for swipes).

premium_owned_shown.doc: The player's premium balance as shown on the offer. Precondition: offer shown.

premium_shown.doc: Premium currency collected in this run, as shown on the HUD.

quit_to_main_menu.doc: Press Exit on the pause menu. Returns once the main menu is shown.

resume.doc: Press Resume on the pause menu. Returns once the run HUD is back.

score_state.doc: The run's score (game state). Precondition: run started.

second_chance_shown.doc: True while the "another chance?" offer is shown.

theme_state.doc: Name of the theme the run takes place in (game state). Precondition: run started.

Settings.doc: The settings popup, opened from the main menu.

cancel_delete.doc: Answer NO to the delete confirmation. Precondition: confirmation shown.

close.doc: Close the popup (the game saves settings here). Precondition: settings open.

confirm_delete.doc: Answer YES to the delete confirmation. Precondition: confirmation shown.

confirmation_shown.doc: True while the delete-data confirmation question is shown.

delete_data.doc:
Press Delete data; returns once the confirmation question is shown.
Precondition: settings open.

is_shown.doc: True when the settings popup is open.

set_master_volume.doc:
Move the master slider to `level` (0.0 to 1.0); the game applies it at once.
Precondition: settings open.

set_music_volume.doc: Move the music slider to `level` (0.0 to 1.0). Precondition: settings open.

set_sound_effects_volume.doc: Move the sound-effects slider to `level` (0.0 to 1.0). Precondition: settings open.

volumes_shown.doc:
Positions of the master, music and sound-effects sliders (0.0 to 1.0).
Precondition: settings open.

Setup.doc: Arrange-only helpers that change the player's data directly.

complete_mission.doc:
Make the active mission at `index` (0 = first) complete by setting its progress to
its target. The missions popup shows it as claimable the next time it opens.

complete_tutorial.doc: Mark the tutorial as completed, so the next run is a normal run.

set_coins.doc: Set the coin balance to `amount` (>= 0) and save.

set_premium.doc: Set the premium balance to `amount` (>= 0) and save.

Store.doc: The store, opened from the main menu or the game-over screen.

accessories.doc: The accessories section; rows are grouped under the character they belong to.

close.doc: Close the store; the screen it was opened from comes back. Precondition: store open.

coins_shown.doc: The coin balance displayed in the store. Precondition: store open.

is_shown.doc: True when the store is the screen in front.

power_ups.doc: The power-ups section (store tab "Items"): Magnet, x2, Invincible, Life.

premium_shown.doc: The premium balance displayed in the store. Precondition: store open.

sections_shown.doc: Labels of the section tabs, in display order. Precondition: store open.

StoreSection.doc: One section (tab) of the store: power-ups, characters, accessories or themes.

buy.doc:
Press Buy on the row `name` and report what the store showed before and after.

The button is pressed even when it is disabled: a refused purchase then shows no
change, after a few seconds of waiting for one. Opens the section first.

item.doc:
The row named `name` (in the accessories section also give the `character` it
belongs to). Opens the section first; raises PGTimeout if no such row is listed.

items.doc: Every row of this section in display order, as shown. Opens the section first.

open.doc: Show this section. Precondition: the store is open. Returns once its rows are listed.

exceptions.PGError: Base class of every error raised by pg_sdk.
exceptions.PGGameError: The game logged an error or exception while the test ran (raised by the pytest plugin).
exceptions.PGInfraError: The device chain failed: driver connection, adb, or the app not running. Never a kill.
exceptions.PGTimeout: A post-condition did not hold in time (screen not shown, item not listed, ...).

HudReadout.doc: The run HUD's values as shown on screen.

LeaderboardEntry.doc: One leaderboard line: its rank as shown, the player name and the score.

Mission.doc:
One mission as listed in the missions popup.

`progress` and `target` come from the "progress / target" text, which the game shows only
while the mission is not complete; both are None for a completed mission. `claimable` is
True when the mission's claim button is shown.

MissionState.doc: One active mission as stored in the player's data (model state).

PurchaseResult.doc: What the store showed just before and just after pressing Buy on one row.

StoreItem.doc:
One row of a store section, as the player sees it.

`character` is set only in the accessories section, where rows are grouped under the
character they belong to. `count` is the number owned, shown on power-up rows only.
`owned` is True when the row's button reads "Owned". A price is "highlighted" when the
store shows it in red because the player cannot cover it.

Volumes.doc: Volume levels on the settings sliders' scale: 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (full).
